entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The green-blue guild of Ravnica, steward of nature and the wild, devoted to biomancy, medicine and the creation of new life forms.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane and city that is home to the guilds.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: The parun after whom the guild was named, who may have been a vedalken biomancer.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Former Simic guildmaster who sought to improve Ravnica's life forms without consent, allied with Svogthir and was killed by Agrus Kos.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: The Boros figure who killed Momir Vig.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: Ally of Momir Vig in Project Kraj.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A merfolk who became Simic guildmaster and speaker of Zonot One; later tried to regain the Prime Speaker position and was murdered.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: Adaptationist who replaced Zegana as Prime Speaker and started the Guardian Project; bound with an ooze.

entities.name: Trifon
entities.description: An amphibious troll who serves as speaker for Zonot Four and supports Vannifar.

entities.name: Zonots
entities.description: Sinkholes leading to Ravnica's rediscovered oceans; nine of them are the focus of Simic activity.

entities.name: Zameck
entities.description: The Simic guildhall in Zonot Seven.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild whose militaristic bent and incursions into Zonot Four threaten the Simic.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild whose members also underwent compleation during the invasion.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker who led the Izzet against Nicol Bolas and convinced the Simic to join.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon the guilds opposed in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Nicol Bolas's invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion during which many Simic underwent compleation.

entities.name: Guardian Project
entities.description: Simic program to magically transfer animal traits into humanoids to build an army of hybrids.

entities.name: Speakers' Chamber
entities.description: Secretive body of all nine Zonot speakers, led by the Prime Speaker.

entities.name: Morska
entities.description: A former member of the Simic Combine.

events.summary: Momir Vig, dissatisfied with the guild, forms a new purpose of improving Ravnica's life forms and creates cytoplasts.
events.quote: formed a new purpose: to improve upon the life forms of Ravnica

events.summary: Vig creates a cytoplast that bonds without consent, since Ravnicans refused to be improved.
events.quote: This allowed Vig to improve the people of Ravnica without needing their consent.

events.summary: Vig allies with Svogthir to activate Project Kraj and is killed by Agrus Kos.
events.quote: He was consequently killed by Agrus Kos .

events.summary: With the rediscovery of the oceans through the Zonots, the Simic are remade from scratch, rejecting Vig's philosophy; Zegana becomes guildmaster.
events.quote: the Simic were remade from scratch

events.summary: After Golgari incursions threaten Zonot Four, Vannifar replaces Zegana as Prime Speaker and begins the Guardian Project.
events.quote: Zegana was replaced as Prime Speaker by Vannifar

events.summary: Ral Zarek leads the Izzet against Bolas in the War of the Spark and convinces the Simic to join.
events.quote: convinced the Simic Combine to join as well

events.summary: Golgari breach Zonot Four and a deep, slow war begins between Simic ecology and Golgari necromancy.
events.quote: has been breached and "infected" with Golgari life forms

events.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion many Simic and Izzet members willingly undergo compleation, causing distrust from other guilds.
events.quote: many Simic willingly underwent compleation to gain more insight into the mutagen

events.summary: After the invasion Zegana tries to regain Prime Speaker and is then brutally murdered; Vannifar seeks other guilds' aid and keeps her position.
The Simic offer healing treatments to the maimed victims of partial compleation, using Phyrexian oil research.
events.quote: the Simic offered healing treatments to work themselves back into the good graces

relations.quote: is the green-blue guild from the plane and city of Ravnica
Zegana was replaced as Prime Speaker by Vannifar

relations.note: Vig was killed after allying with Svogthir.
relations.quote: He was consequently killed by Agrus Kos .
Trifon lent his full support to Vannifar

relations.note: The Golgari are the most significant threat to the Simic.
relations.quote: The most significant threat to the Simic is the Golgari Swarm

relations.note: Vig allied with Svogthir for Project Kraj.

relations.quote: the Simic started the Guardian Project to mutate their more intelligent members into super soldiers
